anchors.description: Length of the white linear fluorescent troffer in the ceiling at top-left, measured along its long axis between the two visible end edges of the diffuser.
anchors.visible_evidence: Recessed linear fluorescent light panel with white diffuser in a suspended acoustical-tile ceiling; the panel spans two ceiling-tile modules with grid joints visible at both ends, consistent with a standard 4 ft troffer.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Troffer width class (1x4 ft vs 2x4 ft) is uncertain, but both standard classes are 4 ft (1.22 m) long, which is the only dimension used.

anchors.description: Vertical height of the large wall-mounted dry-erase whiteboard on the back wall, from its top edge down to its bottom edge above the marker tray, sampled at x=200.
anchors.visible_evidence: Large white dry-erase board with red/black handwriting and a marker tray along its bottom edge, mounted on the back classroom wall; apparent height is consistent with a standard 3-4 ft tall classroom board.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact board product/size is unknown; could be a 36 in (0.91 m) or 48 in (1.22 m) tall board, and image scale at that depth is estimated rather than calibrated.
